segment: 11) Respite care and adult day services

naics_definition: Establishments primarily engaged in providing nonresidential social assistance services to improve the quality of life for the elderly or persons with intellectual and/or developmental disabilities, in areas such as day care, non-medical home care or homemaker services, social activities, group support, and companionship. naics_definition: 621330: establishments of independent mental health practitioners (except physicians) primarily engaged in diagnosis and treatment of mental, emotional, and behavioral disorders and/or of individual or group social dysfunction caused by mental illness, substance abuse, trauma or stress. 621420: establishments with medical staff providing outpatient diagnosis and treatment of mental health disorders and substance abuse. [documented: NAICS Descriptions xlsx]. 624190 description not quoted (index entries only).

naics_category: No clean code for 'benefits navigation'. Closest: third party administration / other insurance related activities; brokers/agents and claims adjusting are neighbours
naics_code: 524298 (All Other Insurance Related Activities, includes insurance advisory services); 524292 (Pharmacy Benefit Management and Other Third Party Administration of Insurance and Pension Funds); also 524210 (Insurance Agencies and Brokerages) and 524291 (Claims Adjusting) for context
naics_definition: 524298: providing insurance services on a contract or fee basis (except agencies and brokerages, claims adjusting, and third party administration); insurance advisory, actuarial and ratemaking services are included. 524292: providing PBM services and other third party administration of insurance and pension funds, such as claims processing and other administrative services to insurance carriers, employee benefit plans, and self-insurance funds. 524210: acting as agents (brokers) in selling annuities and insurance policies. 524291: investigating, appraising, and settling insurance claims. [documented: NAICS Descriptions xlsx]. No code covers consumer help with Medicare.
